summary.text: Mike Saliba is the Libertarian Party candidate for Michigan's 10th District and a repeat Libertarian candidate, having appeared on Michigan ballots in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ran for Michigan State Senate District 10 in 2018 and for U.S. House in Michigan's 9th District in 2020, losing both general elections.
Ran for U.S. House in Michigan's 10th District in 2022 and 2024; in 2024 he received 1.3% of the vote as the Libertarian candidate.
Nominated at the Libertarian convention on June 28, 2026.
